headline: Instagram Follows Checker - Track Followers &
short_description: A tool for checking who is following you on Instagram and identifying those who do not follow you back. It compares your list of followers with those you are following and outputs the results to text files.
author: dante4rt

sections.overview:
Instagram Follows Checker is a tool that compares your Instagram followers with those you follow to identify non-reciprocal relationships. It works by processing JSON data exported directly from Instagram's download-your-data feature, then generating two output files: one listing users who follow you back, and another showing users who don't. The tool requires minimal setup—just download your Instagram connection data in JSON format, place the files in the project directory, and run npm start. This helps users manage their social media presence by quickly identifying followers who aren't reciprocating.
Identify Instagram followers who don't follow you back
Clean up your following list by spotting non-reciprocal follows
Generate reports of mutual followers for social media audits
Manage Instagram relationships by reviewing follower discrepancies
sections.setup:

sections.usage:
```
I need to check who is following me on Instagram and identify those who do not follow me back. Please compare my list of followers with those I am following. My Instagram username is [USERNAME]. Output the results to text files.
```
